answer_3.quote: We evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs as conflict detectors, including Mixtral-8x7b, Llama 3 8B Instruct, Llama 3 70B Instruct, Claude 3 Haiku, Claude 3 Sonnet, GPT-4... The models are prompted to generate {Yes, No} predictions on whether a pair of evidence is conflicting.

answer_4.quote: Human annotations demonstrate that generated data labels exhibit high quality. We randomly sampled 200 pairs ... each pair ... is annotated by three independent annotators to determine its label from {Conflicting, Non-conflicting, Not sure}. The Fleiss' κ among the annotators is 71.2%, which indicates substantial inter-annotator agreement.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to label each evidence pair as Conflicting, Non-conflicting, or Not sure.
